relations.rationale: Arriving earliest than everyone is consistent with and supports arriving well before sunrise.

Early arrival timing is unrelated to weather conditions staying clear throughout the event.
Arrival timing has nothing to do with bike reach comparisons.
Alma's early arrival time has no bearing on Pia and Tess discussing future plans.
Vik being younger than Tess doesn't establish or contradict his age relative to Alma.

Zeno finishing ahead of Vik doesn't determine whether Pia finished ahead of Vik.
